facts.fact: 春天的风暴把 Allard 家院子枫树的一根大树枝刮落，砸在 Tori 的屋顶上，悬在那里随时可能掉
facts.anchor: A spring storm had dislodged a large branch from the maple tree in the Allards’ yard

facts.fact: Autumn 说树枝清掉之前她不肯带 Leo 去后院
facts.anchor: Autumn had said that she didn’t want to go out in the backyard with Leo until it had been removed

facts.fact: Tori 对 Autumn 撒谎，说房东这个周末会派人来处理
周五夜里她一个人泡在浴缸里，抱着一瓶酒哭
facts.anchor: Tori had curled up in her bathtub with a bottle of wine and cried

facts.fact: 提醒她正在拿自己孩子冒险的，是一个 22 岁的邻居
facts.anchor: She needed a twenty-two-year-old to tell her that she was endangering her own child

facts.fact: 这栋房子是前夫挑的、用前夫的名字租的、由前夫付钱
facts.anchor: her ex had picked this place out, had rented it in his name, and was paying for it

facts.fact: Daniel 从 Home Depot 买了个新垃圾桶，因为她那只还是裂的
facts.anchor: I was at Home Depot. I noticed on trash day you still had the cracked one.

facts.fact: 不到十五分钟 Daniel 就架起金属伸缩梯爬上去
facts.anchor: Less than fifteen minutes later, he had returned and was propping a metal extension ladder

facts.fact: 她端出的"自制"烤鸡沙拉其实是 Autumn 做的，她这辈子没烤过鸡
facts.anchor: She didn’t mention that Autumn had made it

facts.fact: 客厅和吸顶音响系统都是 Jo 设计的
facts.anchor: his wife was the one who had designed the seamless sound system

facts.fact: Daniel 说自己婚了二十多年，有时完全认不出妻子
facts.anchor: I’ve been married more than twenty years, but sometimes I don’t recognize my wife at all

facts.fact: 她凑上去亲他之后，他脸上是无法掩饰的厌恶
Daniel 说答应吃饭只是因为她看起来又孤独又难过，他同情她
facts.anchor: I said yes to dinner because you seemed so lonely, so sad. I felt sorry for you.

facts.fact: 章末她不再想当笑柄，只想找到先下手的方法
facts.anchor: If only there was a way to hit first
